correctness.rationale: For exactly the sixteen vertices and twenty-four edges, full independent-triple enumeration yields 276 facets and 64,900 faces including empty. Every one of the 32,432 matching incidences is between a face and its one-vertex extension and disjoint; an independent topological sort of the complete 516,080-incidence reversed Hasse digraph visits all faces, certifying acyclicity. Its 36 unpaired 10-faces and initially paired empty face imply one 0-cell and 36 10-cells after standard unpairing, hence an integral wedge of 36 spheres. Orientation-corrected fixed-face alternating sums for all eight symmetries yield traces (36,0,4,0,6,6,6,6). The independent 36-unordered-cell-pair module check gives the same traces; Maschke and rational D4 character theory establish the abstract isomorphism. The included exact checker ran to VERIFY_OK. No infinite-family assertion or integral D4-module isomorphism is inferred.

value.rationale: This natural four-by-four square case extends exact homotopy understanding beyond the published two- and three-row families. The complete wedge-of-36-ten-spheres simple-CW description strengthens a previously known Betti count for a pure twelve-dimensional complex. The full rational D4 module determines symmetry-invariant and sign sectors and unexpectedly matches the permutation module of unordered pairs of the nine geometric unit-square faces; this is independently meaningful equivariant topological data, not a mere renaming of the rank.
